metadata.description: Historical, offline-serving Candidate TP3 recipe for the GLM 5.2 NVFP4/AQLM hybrid vision checkpoint. It is unsupported on Vonk's current one- or two-Spark configuration: a two-rank split alone would require at least 146.3 GB of checkpoint bytes per Spark before KV cache or runtime overhead, above the roughly 126.9 GB-per-node inventory. The executable contract remains installable for a future three-Spark canary; glm-5-3-flash-exl3-dflash2-vllm-dual is the current 126 GB-admission-envelope GLM alternative.
metadata.title: GLM 5.2 AQLM three Sparks
